lessons.title: Use SLSQP with equality constraints
lessons.summary: Optimization with SLSQP and equality constraints ensures the sum constraint is satisfied.

lessons.summary: Ensure the objective function and constraints are correctly defined to avoid runtime errors.
lessons.lesson: Define the objective function to compute the maximum cross-correlation and the constraint function to enforce the sum constraint correctly.

lessons.title: Handle optimization failures gracefully
